label: Synthetic sample house
axes: house axes: x east, y north, z up, origin at the south west corner of the footprint's bounding box, whole inches; a box is in its side frame: x along the wall from its start corner, its right end as seen from the yard, y out from the wall face, z up from the ground
visible_rule: a hazard is visible on a frame when its pixels in the render's mask pass number at least 200; its box is the tightest rectangle round them
box_source: tightest rectangle round the pixels of the hazard in a flat colour pass of the render, one pass per frame
